tencent-video-hot-trend v0.1.0

- Initial release: Register Tencent Video hot trend skill for summary and analysis of public content.
- Supports fetching public series/variety/movie summaries (status, episodes, ratings/comments).
- Allows ranking statistics and program episode/guest info extraction.
- No downloading, reverse engineering, or bypassing of platform restrictions.
- Results intended for lightweight internal analysis and notifications only.
